objective: Fix Marites compact preview photo failures: pass durable private Storage paths into signed-media cache and Full View with no changed permissions
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub source readback confirms production-main commit 59e4c1dff5200eec72a37ec065ecacbc23f0fe99 is this hotfix branch's exact parent; that commit is explicitly labeled production promotion and contains the unified five-feature source. GitHub evidence verifies ancestry and release metadata only—not installed OTA receipt, live production rendering, or new hotfix publication. Independent production artifact fingerprint required.
chosenApproach: Keep photo URL and corresponding private media path aligned in all collage tiles and Full View. Existing bounded private signed-URL cache can re-sign after expiry without changing audience rules. Allow the already guarded Android/Web RC export job for the exact isolated hotfix branch, retaining every production credential, runtime and compiled artifact check.
selectionRationale: Marites collage discarded photo_paths; the shared image component cannot renew failed signed URLs without them. Fresh Full View sometimes reloaded the same stored image, matching screenshot.
